subject: SecureLink partner ops: evidence liaison, connectivity & escalation plan
messages:
From: Lauren Mitchell <lauren.mitchell@securelink.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SecureLink onboarding — connectivity checklist + kickoff

Hi Mina / Sergio —

Thanks again for taking the time to speak yesterday. Per our conversation, attaching a short checklist and a draft SOW to get the assurance/integration work started. High-level asks:

- We need a point of contact for evidence handoff (SFTP / signed GCS bucket).
- Clarify retention and encryption requirements for artifacts (SOC2 artifacts, pen-test reports).
- Confirm escalation path for any failed transfers or access denials.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync next week to confirm connectivity and role matrix. We're flexible on Tuesday/Wednesday AM PT.

Attachments:
[Attachment: SecureLink_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx]
[Attachment: SecureLink_SOW_draft.docx]

Quick context on SecureLink: we operate a partner gateway that pulls evidence from customer GRC platforms (read-only) and stages compressed bundles for auditors; we want Redwood as the primary evidence provider for the joint customers in Q3.

Thanks,
Lauren Mitchell
Head of Integrations | SecureLink
lauren.mitchell@securelink.ai | +1 415-555-0143

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Mitchell <lauren.mitchell@securelink.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SecureLink onboarding — connectivity checklist + kickoff

Lauren —

Appreciate the materials. We're aligned on the ask and can run a short technical kickoff. A few clarifying notes before the call: 

- Evidence transfer: Redwood can support both SFTP push and time-limited signed GCS buckets. For shared customers we prefer GCS signed URLs (short-lived) + object-level encryption with CMEK.
- Retention: default retention for exported artifacts is 90 days; we can set per-customer retention in Dedicated configs — please confirm if SecureLink requires >90 days.
- Pen-test handling: pen-test reports must be restricted to a named auditor group and stored encrypted; we also need to capture access logs for 12 months (audit requirement).

Can Sergio host a technical run-through on Wednesday 04/07 at 09:30 PT? If that works we'll send a calendar invite and a pre-call checklist.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Director, Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Subject: Re: SecureLink onboarding — connectivity checklist + kickoff

Mina / Lauren —

Adding AuditWorks' perspective since pen-test artifacts and SOC2 evidence are in scope for a number of the named customers. A couple of items we need to lock down before the kickoff run: 

1) Evidence manifest: please provide a sample manifest format (CSV/JSON) with fields for artifact type, creation timestamp, source system, and SHA256. AuditWorks requires SHA256 and creation timestamps to validate chain of custody.

2) Encryption and key custody: If Redwood uses CMEK, who holds the keys? For customers using customer-managed keys we need to confirm HSM integration and rotation schedule.

3) Access auditing: we need syslog or an exported access log feed (s3/gcs) that includes user id, action, object, and timestamp. Retention 12 months minimum.

If you can attach an example manifest and a short diagram of the transfer flow (who signs the URLs, where artifacts land, where audit logs are captured), that will speed approvals on our side.

Thanks,
Tom Reed
Senior Assurance Manager | AuditWorks
Tom.Reed@auditworks.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Mitchell <lauren.mitchell@securelink.ai>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@auditworks.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SecureLink onboarding — connectivity checklist + kickoff

All —

Thanks for the questions — here's a short operational plan (we'll iterate after the tech sync):

1) Roles & ownership
- Redwood evidence liaison: Mina Haddad (primary) / Vanessa Ortiz (backup)
- SecureLink connector owner: Lauren Mitchell
- Auditor contact: Tom Reed (AuditWorks)

2) Transfer flow (summary)
- Redwood generates signed GCS URLs (15m TTL) and places artifacts in a customer-scoped staging bucket (CMEK).
- SecureLink pulls bundles, verifies SHA256 from manifest, and stages for auditors.
- Audit logs (object access) are exported to a dedicated logs bucket and forwarded to the customer's SIEM via pub/sub.

3) Escalation matrix
- Level 1 (transfer failures): SecureLink ops -> Redwood evidence liaison (within 2 hours)
- Level 2 (data integrity issues): AuditWorks + Redwood sec -> joint triage (within 8 hours)
- Level 3 (regulatory exposure): Exec escalation (CTO / Head of Trust) and legal loop-in (within 24 hours)

4) Deliverables pre-tech-sync
- Example manifest (CSV) — attached.
- short transfer diagram (link in Drive).
- SOW redlines incorporated, see comments in DocX.

Next steps: we'll send a calendar invite for Wed 04/07 09:30 PT with the dial-in and a short agenda (15m tech, 10m ops, 5m next steps).

Attachments:
